title: Joseph-Rus/study-stash
summary: Free, open-source AI lecture recorder and note-taker for students on Mac and Windows. Records and transcribes lectures on your computer (Whisper, Parakeet) and writes study notes with diagrams using Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or a free local AI (Ollama). Works with Canvas.

title: Shinjiru-stack/kestrel
summary: Cluster intelligence with a human in the loop. Live Kubernetes observability, evidence-grounded AI diagnosis, and approval-gated remediation.

title: LHagfoss/rustcode
summary: Agent Harness or sum

title: raro42/mac-stats
summary: Menu-bar system monitor for Apple Silicon (optional local AI agent). Rust + Tauri. No cloud telemetry.

title: opod-io/opod-core
summary: Self-hosted AI gateway for the GPUs you already own: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint across many machines. Engine-agnostic (Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, MLX-LM), load-aware routing, one model sharded across nodes, API keys, Prometheus + OpenTelemetry. Go, Apache-2.0, no telemetry.

title: aisixteen/fantastic
summary: A medium that unifies humans and AIs into a single workspace: a kernel where models, programs, files, shells and a live canvas are all agents, reached by one call.

title: TheOriUHD/atelier
summary: A self-hosted AI workspace with Chat, Cowork and Code, on the models you choose

title: yakovkhalinsky/llm-world
summary: Small worlds on a small local LLM: Grove (forest) and Highfield (housing estate). Deterministic sims, the LLM as a voice, isometric 2D and 3D views. Fully offline.

title: jonathanferwerda/jawnos
summary: A personal, self-hosted operating environment: a Perl/Mojolicious OS-in-a-browser for files, media, appointments, budgeting, location logging and handheld devices.

title: henksys/basicagent
summary: A scriptable and interactive command line agent with web-interface, file tools, web-fetch, skills, image input, and OpenAI-compatible LLM providers.

title: Stelios-developer/padel-club-management-platform
summary: Padel club platform: Java 21/Spring Boot microservices, PostgreSQL booking constraints, RabbitMQ outbox, Keycloak OIDC and local Spring AI/Ollama RAG. Responsive Greek UI, Testcontainers, contracts and OpenTelemetry.

title: WindriderQc/AgentX
summary: Local AI workbench: Ollama chat, document retrieval, model evaluation and optional personal and household interfaces.

title: cmcoffee/gohort
summary: Your agent has agents. A self-hosted, local-first AI agent platform in one Go binary: agents hand work to specialists and build the tools, agents and apps they lack, with sandboxed tools and credentials the model never sees.

title: Arynwood-Technology/ArynwoodMCP
summary: A local-first personal AI and creative workspace for Linux and Windows desktops: Ollama chat, knowledge search, a design canvas and MCP tool integrations, including Kdenlive. Alpha.

title: malsabbagh/review-sensei
summary: Provider-neutral AI code review engine with an Ollama/OpenRouter adapters.

title: LeeGeller/neurohunter
summary: NeuroHunter — open-source сервис для персонализированного поиска и анализа вакансий, учитывающий профессиональную квалификацию, жёсткие ограничения кандидата и совместимость с рабочей средой.

title: chanto-sh/chanto
summary: A fast, lean coding agent for your terminal. Any model, local or hosted.

title: metadist/synaplan
summary: Open-source, self-hosted AI platform (PHP/Symfony): chat with any model, RAG over your docs, embeddable widget, MCP — see the cost of every answer. Apache-2.0.

title: sandraschi/tvtropes-mcp
summary: TVTropes local mirror + MCP server. Polite background crawler (curl_cffi), Ollama extraction, 11 FastMCP tools, React dashboard, Calibre integration.

title: alessioricco/Certo
summary: A coding-agent harness that isn't tied to one model or provider: it picks a model per task, switches when one fails, and checks the work with your own tests.
